notes.title: Color wheel in editor and bug fixes in color achievements
notes.content:
- Improved the interface for selecting fish colors with a color wheel and a picker with colors tied to in-game achievements.

- Fixed a bug where the color achievement unlocked when creating a fish did not correspond to the color selected in the editor.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where the color achievement unlocked when creating a fish did not correspond to the color selected in the editor.

notes.title: Function added to delimit swimming zones for each fish
notes.content:
-Added the function to delimit the swimming zones allowed for each fish, allowing the user to now better direct the selective breeding of fish, or group the fish outside the work zones of the screen.
- Fixed a bug in which achievements could exceed 100%
- Introduced merojas to optimize the use of resources

notes.title: Improved Fish Creation Menu, Optimization
notes.content:
- The menus dedicated to creating fish have been improved, making it more user-friendly
- Bugs related to fish that did not disappear when dying or that when disappearing caused the game to slow down have been fixed
- Several aspects of the code have been optimized to improve performance.

notes.title: Improved algae system, information and death
notes.content:
- Algae only spawn in the taskbar so they don't clutter up the screen
- Algae have a higher reproduction rate so it's rarer for fish to prey on them all
- The price of selling algae has been lowered
- Fish can no longer starve to death, but not eating will stop them from growing
- The number of algae that can be spawned before they stop spawning has been increased from 5 to 10
- The game's operation is explained in more detail in the information panel
- When fish die of old age, they now give you 80% of their value, so that the user can stop worrying about their fish and place them in the background with greater confidence.
